name: KasuVideo Companion
description: Made for KasuVideo, a web frontend for Jellyfin. Plugins can add entries to KasuVideo's item menus and pages to its Dashboard by publishing a manifest (a *.kasuvideo.json page). Jellyfin lists plugin pages to administrators only, so without this plugin only administrators see those additions; with it, every signed-in KasuVideo user does. It also tells KasuVideo's administrators what each plugin does for the server: the Jellyfin interfaces its classes implement (metadata and picture providers, scheduled tasks, services...) and the API routes it adds. It has no settings, no pages and no effect on Jellyfin's own web client, and changes nothing on the server. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 (source: https://github.com/WaterBlueNewWorld/KasuVideo-Companion).
overview: Lets KasuVideo show what your other plugins add to it, for every user

versions.changelog: 0.1.0: first release. Serves plugins' KasuVideo manifests to every signed-in user (GET /KasuVideo/Companion/Manifests) and tells administrators what each plugin implements (GET /KasuVideo/Companion/Implementations). Contract 1.
